messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on service `gateway-frontend` (api-gateway). Symptoms: spike in 504/timeouts + uptick in 502s across eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Rule: gateway.5xx_rate > 3% (2m). Auto-notified @kevin. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gateway-5xx

kevin: oncall here, acking. digging into metrics now — thanks for the ping.

maria: any obvious customer impact yet? are we seeing error budget burn or any big tenants?

kevin: quick numbers — QPS steady, but 5xx proportion peaked ~4.8% for ~3m starting 1971234500. Most 5xx are timeouts/504s from upstream cache/proxy layer. No automatic rollback triggered.

sanjay: trying traces but sampling is low (10%). spans for many of the 504s are missing. also seeing a lot of requests without `X-Request-Id` headers which makes correlation hard.

opsbot: telemetry snapshot: 22% of sampled 5xx entries missing request-id. Top upstream causing 504s: `edge-cache-v2` and `tts-proxy`. CPU on edge-cache nodes at 85% for last 10m.

kevin: can we temporarily bump trace sampling and enable request-id injection on the gateway so we can correlate? also want to enable debug logging on a single pod to capture headers for a minute.

lina: i rolled a small lb-proxy change last night (deploy d24f5b) that touched header rewrites. rolling that back now would take ~5m. link: https://git.redwood/infra/commits/d24f5b

kevin: let's do a conservative plan:
1) enable 100% trace sampling on gateway for 10m
2) enable request-id injection filter in envoy (temporary)
3) scale gateway replicas +2 in eu-west-1 and us-east-1
4) shift 8% traffic to us-west-2 as fallback pool
5) attach header-logging sidecar to one gateway pod for live inspection

kevin: commands to apply (ops runbook snippets) — careful with tokens:
```bash
# set tracing env on deployment
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/gateway-frontend TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0
# bump replicas
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/gateway-frontend --replicas=$(kubectl -n prod get deploy gateway-frontend -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}' | xargs -I{} echo $(({} + 2)))
# envoy admin: enable debug logging on pod
kubectl -n prod exec -it deploy/gateway-frontend -c envoy -- bash -c "curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:9901/logging?level=debug"
```

opsbot: ran a quick `kubectl` probe on one pod — request-id header absent for ~30% of requests through gateway-frontend-3. Heap/CPU for that pod look ok; latency higher on egress to edge-cache.

maria: CS update: two customers reported increased error rates via support tickets — both on EU endpoints. CS triaged and asked for ETA. Please include a short summary for them.

kevin: short sample log (sanitized) showing missing header and 504 from upstream: 
```
[2026-05-02T12:34:56Z] INFO "GET /v1/generate" host=api.redwood svc=gateway-frontend upstream=edge-cache-v2 status=504 latency=1789ms headers={Authorization:***, content-type:application/json} note="no X-Request-Id"
```

sanjay: propose a stopgap instrumentation: sidecar that logs inbound/outbound headers for responses with status>=500 and includes full upstream timing. lightweight Fluentd sidecar with filter. Example config fragment: 
```yaml
# sidecar (snippet)
containers:
  - name: header-logger
    image: internal/sidecars/header-logger:stable
    env:
      - name: LOG_FILTER_STATUS
        value: ">=500"
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: 100m
        memory: 128Mi
```

lina: i'll start the rollback of d24f5b in lb-proxy if we see no regression from tracing changes. that should remove header rewrite risk.

kevin: owners & quick ETA:
- sanjay -> enable tracing + sidecar + logs (10m)
- lina -> rollback lb-proxy if tracing confirms header loss source (15m)
- ops -> scale + traffic shift (5m after green light)
- maria -> CS note & incident comms (5m)

kevin: live mitigation steps executed:
- TRACE_SAMPLING set to 1.0 (applied to all gateway pods) :white_check_mark:
- header-logger sidecar injected on gateway-frontend-3 :white_check_mark: (collecting)
- scaling started, +2 replicas queued :arrow_up_small:
- traffic shift scheduled to 8% to us-west-2 via trafficrouter (pending)

opsbot: header-logger captured first sample: found missing `X-Request-Id` on requests that originated from lb-proxy with route rewrite header `x-rw-route: stick`. collecting more.

maria: CS updates sent to affected tenants with ETA ~30m, referencing incident id INC-197123.

kevin: handing off active monitoring to @oncall-night in 20m — i'll stay on to confirm rollback if needed then sign out. summary for handoff: elevated 504s tied to `edge-cache-v2` egress; missing request-id appears correlated with lb-proxy rewrite d24f5b; tracing enabled and header-logger sidecar collecting; scaling + traffic shift in progress. docs + runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/gateway-5xx

oncall-night: acked. i'll watch dashboards, escalate if 5xx > 3% persists for another 10m. will coordinate with infra to finish rollback if traces point there.

kevin: quick checklist for followup (post-incident):
- revert temporary TRACE_SAMPLING=1.0 after investigation (sanitized traces)
- keep header-logger data for 72h then purge
- add automated alert if X-Request-Id missing > 5% in 5m
- test lb-proxy header rewrite in staging more thoroughly

maria: thanks everyone — please post a short postmortem w/ timeline after incident closure. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident thread updated: status=mitigating, incident_id=INC-197123, severity=high. PagerDuty: acknowledged by kevin.
